title: Wind down the deal entity
summary: File final returns, close accounts, terminate the entity and keep the records the law requires.
outlineSteps: Read the governing agreement's dissolution terms
Confirm the sale has closed and the final distribution has gone out
Pay or reserve for remaining liabilities and claims
Cancel contracts, insurance and utility accounts no longer needed
File the final federal return and final K-1s
File the final state tax reports
Release any remaining holdback to investors
File the entity's termination with the state
Tell investors the entity is closed
Set a retention schedule and store the records
